data.body: RCA confirmed (rebar-debug fast path): the tickets cache-hit branch in materialize_tickets (src/rebar/_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py, 'if dest.is_dir(): return str(dest)') returns without cache.touch_entry, while cache.acquire touches on all three hit re-checks (cache.py:248,255,259); the janitor sorts eviction victims LRU-first by entry_mtime (janitor.py:474). Contract violated: ADR 0005 D4 ('the cache bumps mtime explicitly on every hit'). Fix: call touch_entry(dest) on the hit branch (deferred import — cache imports repo_snapshot, so module-level would cycle). RED->GREEN: test_materialize_tickets_bumps_mtime_on_cache_hit (frozen mtime observed RED) and test_hot_tickets_entry_is_not_first_lru_victim (hot tickets- entry was first LRU victim RED) in tests/unit/test_snapshot_janitor.py; both GREEN after the one-line fix. lint/typecheck/complexity ratchet all pass.
